db:info.db:title: TestDate Class
db:info.db:titleabbrev: QDoc multiple overloads test Reference Documentation

db:section.db:title: Detailed Description
db:section.db:para: This class tests whether QDoc incorrectly reports "Multiple primary overloads" when different classes have methods with the same name, using shared comment nodes.

db:section.db:title: void TestDate::toString() const
db:section.db:para: Returns the date as a string. The format parameter determines the format of the result string.
This uses shared comment nodes (multiple \fn commands) just like Eddy's qtbase change, which triggers the bug.

db:section.db:title: void TestDate::toString(const char *formatString) const
db:section.db:para: Returns the date as a string using the specified formatString.
